description: Searches package names and descriptions on npm, crates.io, Packagist, RubyGems and NuGet, returning name, version, description, downloads where the registry gives them, licence, repository and last publish date. PyPI has no search API: it is checked by exact name only. Registries that fail are listed in unavailable. Limit per registry max 10. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ecosystems.description: Comma list of npm, crates, packagist, rubygems, nuget, pypi (default: all)

name: package_search
title: Package Search
